Please solve this issue: We are building Quizzy, a live quiz app for conference talks, as a Ruby on Rails application. Start in the `/app` Git repository. It has no app yet. Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, the gems of a default `rails new` app, SQLite, and Chromium are installed. You can install other gems from rubygems.org; other network access is blocked. Install all dependencies while you work: we verify the app without network access.

Feel free to store any design notes/insights that could be useful for future steps in the docs/ folder.

How we run the app:

- We start it with `bin/serve` from the project root and these environment variables: `RAILS_ENV=production`, `PORT=3000`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`.
- `bin/serve` prepares everything the app needs (the database, assets, and so on) and runs the app in production mode in the foreground. It listens on all interfaces on `PORT`.
- The app is served over plain HTTP (no SSL, no HTTPS redirects) and accepts any host name.
- `GET /up` responds with `200` when the app is ready.
- The app keeps all its data under `storage/`. It must not call external services.

Our QA auto-tests drive the app in a browser and rely on the labels in quotes in each task. Keep them exactly as written, as visible text, a <label>, a placeholder, or an aria-label.

The QA auto-tests also expect:

- Each item of a list (a quiz, a question) sits in its own list item or table row, with its buttons and links inside it.
- Switches are checkboxes (a styled switch is fine if a real checkbox sits under it).
- Confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()` dialog.

Quizzy runs quizzes during conference talks. A moderator shows the questions on the big screen, and the audience answers on their phones. The first release covers the moderator's side: preparing quizzes.

The design is in `docs/mockups/`, exported from our design tool: a style guide and two screens of this release (the quiz page and the question form), each as a static HTML page (open it in a browser) and a PNG. The stylesheet and the font next to them are the design's assets: use them as they are or adapt them. Follow the look: colors, typography, pill buttons, and layout. Big-screen pages run on LED walls and projectors; player pages run on phones.

The moderator area lives under `/moderate`. Every page in it requires HTTP Basic authentication with the credentials from `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME` and `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`. Missing or wrong credentials get `401`.

Quizzes:

- `/moderate` lists the quizzes and has the "New quiz" button.
- The quiz form has one field, "Title" (required), and the "Save quiz" button. Saving opens the quiz page.
- The quiz page shows the title and the questions in order. It has the "Add question" button, the "Settings" link and the "Preview" link.
- "Settings" opens the same quiz form for the quiz, and the "Delete quiz" button, which asks for confirmation.

Questions are single-choice with text options. The question form has:

- "Question": the question text (required)
- option rows: each row has a text field labelled "Option 1", "Option 2", and so on, and a checkbox labelled "Option 1 is correct", "Option 2 is correct", and so on. A new question starts with four empty rows. The "Add option" button adds one more row with the next number.
- "Active": a checkbox, on by default
- the "Save question" button

Rules for options:

- Empty rows are skipped.
- A question needs at least two options. Otherwise the form shows "Add at least two options".
- At least one option must be correct (several correct options are fine). Otherwise the form shows "Mark at least one option as correct".
- When a rule fails, nothing is saved and the form keeps what the moderator typed.

Each question on the quiz page shows its text and its options, with the correct options marked. It also has:

- "Move up" and "Move down" buttons that change the order
- the "Active" checkbox: changing it saves at once, with no extra button
- the "Edit" link to the question form
- the "Delete" button, which asks for confirmation

Inactive questions stay on the quiz page, but the preview skips them.

The preview lets the moderator try the quiz as a player would. It goes through the active questions in order, one at a time:

- It shows the progress ("Question 1 of 3"), the question text, and the options as buttons.
- Picking an option shows "Correct!" or "Wrong!" and reveals the correct options.
- The "Next question" button opens the next question. After the last question, the "See score" button shows the result, for example "Score: 2/3".
- The "Start over" button restarts the preview. Preview answers are not stored anywhere.

cd /app && cat <<'EOF' > docs/architecture.md
# Quizzy Architecture & Design Notes

## Overview

Quizzy is a Rails 8.1 application using SQLite (`storage/`), Propshaft, Importmap, Turbo, Stimulus, and Solid Cable / Solid Cache / Solid Queue (all configured to store data exclusively under `storage/` with zero external service calls).

## Boot & Production Serving (`bin/serve`)

- `bin/serve` sets `RAILS_ENV=production` and `PORT` (default `3000`), precompiles assets (`bin/rails assets:precompile`), prepares SQLite databases (`bin/rails db:prepare`), and runs Puma in the foreground bound to `0.0.0.0:$PORT`.
- Plain HTTP is used (`config.assume_ssl = false`, `config.force_ssl = false`) and all hostnames are accepted (`config.hosts.clear`).
- `GET /up` serves the public health check (`200 OK`).
- Every route under `/moderate` inherits from `Moderate::BaseController`, which enforces HTTP Basic Authentication against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` and `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD"]`.

## Data Model (Release 1: Preparing Quizzes)

- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required, whitespace-normalized). Has many `questions` ordered by `(position, id)` and `active_questions` (`where(active: true)`).
- `Question` (`questions`): belongs to `quiz`; `body` (required), `active` (boolean, default `true`), `position` (integer). Has many `options` ordered by `(position, id)`.
  - `Question#save_with_option_rows` skips blank option rows, validates at least 2 non-empty options (`"Add at least two options"`) and at least 1 correct non-empty option (`"Mark at least one option as correct"`), and atomically replaces options in a transaction while preserving submitted rows in-memory on validation failure.
  - `move_up!` / `move_down!` swap `position` with the adjacent question in a transaction.
- `Option` (`options`): belongs to `question`; `body` (required), `correct` (boolean, default `false`), `position` (integer).

## Frontend & Design System (`quizzy.css`)

- `app/assets/stylesheets/quizzy.css` and `app/assets/fonts/Inter-latin.woff2` come directly from `docs/mockups/`.
- Note for future releases: `quizzy.css` already includes pre-built styles for upcoming features:
  - **Big-screen presentation**: `.cover`, `.cover--blue`, `.cover--night`, `.screen`, `.screen-controls`, `.lobby`, `.qr`, `.counter-pill`, `.stage-question__*`, `.stage-options`, `.stage-option.is-correct`, `.leaderboard`, `.leader.is-winner`.
  - **Mobile participant play**: `.play`, `.join-form`, `.waiting`, `.waiting__gem`, `.play-options`, `.play-option`, `.play-status--right`, `.play-status--wrong`, `.result-card`, `.winner-banner`.
  - **Moderator responses**: `.tabs`, `.tab`, `.mark`, `.response-options`, `.response-option`, `.runs-table`, `.badge--running`, `.badge--finished`.
- Stimulus controllers:
  - `option-rows` (`app/javascript/controllers/option_rows_controller.js`): dynamically adds/removes and renumbers option rows (`Option N` / `Option N is correct`) on the question form.
  - `active-toggle` (`app/javascript/controllers/active_toggle_controller.js`): immediately persists `Active` checkbox changes via `fetch(..., { keepalive: true })` and updates active counts/numbering in-place.
- Moderator Preview (`Moderate::PreviewsController#show`): stateless `GET`-driven flow through `quiz.active_questions` in order without writing any database or session state.
EOF

steps.message:
We have built the Quizzy Ruby on Rails application in `/app` covering quiz preparation and preview for moderators:

- **Production Boot & Configuration (`bin/serve`)**: Prepares precompiled assets via Propshaft (`quizzy.css` and `Inter-latin.woff2` from `docs/mockups/`) and SQLite databases under `storage/`, running Puma in the foreground bound to `0.0.0.0:$PORT` over plain HTTP, accepting any hostname, serving `/up` (`200 OK`), and making zero external network calls.
- **Moderator Authentication (`/moderate`)**: Enforces HTTP Basic authentication on all moderator endpoints using `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME` and `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD` (`401 Unauthorized` on missing or invalid credentials).
- **Quizzes Management**: Lists quizzes in individual list items on `/moderate` with `"New quiz"`, creates and edits quizzes via `"Title"` and `"Save quiz"`, provides `"Settings"` with `"Delete quiz"` using native `confirm()`, and renders `"Add question"` and `"Preview"` on the quiz page.
- **Questions & Options**: Implements the question form with `"Question"`, 4 initial option rows (`"Option N"` and `"Option N is correct"`), dynamic `"Add option"` via Stimulus, `"Active"` (checked by default), `"Save question"`, option validation rules (`"Add at least two options"`, `"Mark at least one option as correct"`, skipping empty rows, preserving user input on failure), `"Move up"` / `"Move down"` reordering, instant `"Active"` checkbox persistence, `"Edit"`, and `"Delete"` with native `confirm()`.
- **Quiz Preview**: Steps through active questions in order (`"Question X of Y"`), displays options as buttons, reveals `"Correct!"` / `"Wrong!"` along with all correct options, advances via `"Next question"` to `"See score"` (`"Score: X/Y"`), and supports `"Start over"` without storing preview answers anywhere.
- **Documentation & Tests**: Added architecture notes in `docs/architecture.md` along with model, integration, and headless Chromium system tests.

Let's submit our final output now.
